questions.question: What did the returned exiles build first?
options: The altar of the God of Israel
The roof of the ruined temple
questions.answer: The altar of the God of Israel

questions.question: How did the people react when the temple foundation was laid?
options: They fled the city in sudden fear
They rose up in anger against the leaders
They stood in complete and uneasy silence
Some shouted for joy while old men wept
questions.answer: Some shouted for joy while old men wept

questions.question: They kept the Feast of Booths and offered burnt offerings even before the temple was built.
